answer: Anyone running 195 aliases as a result needs 60 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in meadow, expire in copper, and nebula lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4773 identities would post 2921 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
